verdict:
## QA Review — Backyard Designer 3D (Keyboard Shortcuts modal open)

**Blocking issues:** none found.

**Minor observations (all non-blocking, mostly artifacts of the transient modal):**

1. **[Minor] "Excavate" button occluded** — bottom-right button reads "...cavate" because the shortcuts modal covers its left edge. Expected layering while the guide is open, but worth confirming the full label renders once the modal is dismissed.
2. **[Cosmetic] Orphaned "Daytime" tooltip** — a small dark chip floats detached above the modal (top-center). It belongs to the Sun slider that's hidden behind the modal, so it looks stray. Suggest hiding tooltips when a modal is open.
3. **[Cosmetic] Compass needle overflow** — the red north needle appears to poke slightly past the dial circle's edge at bottom-right.
4. **[Note] FPS reads "1"** in the status bar — either a stall while the modal blocks rendering or a measurement artifact; not a visual defect but worth a perf check.
5. **[Note] Panel stacking** — the shortcuts modal sits atop the (partially visible) settings/lighting panel, making the background busy. All actual clipping in this capture is standard modal occlusion, not broken layout. The scrim correctly dims the canvas, tool cluster, and bottom bar.

**Clarity check (5-second test):** Passes. The modal is self-explanatory — clear title, "Press ? or F1" hint, tidy two-column shortcut layout with a full-width "Got it!" dismiss. Left panel ("ADD TO YOUR YARD") and status bar (Tool / Brush / Height) communicate the app's purpose well. Undo/Redo and Bird's-eye correctly read as disabled states; blue "ADV" badges consistently mark advanced-only items.

**Internal layout of the modal itself:** clean — no clipped chips, labels, or wrapped text; spacing and alignment are consistent throughout.

**Verdict:** Ship-able — no blocking defects; only cosmetic items are the clipped "Excavate" button, stray "Daytime" tooltip, and the FPS reading, all tied to the transient overlay state.
